map.血友病 FVIII/FIX 替代治疗器 使用指南: Hemophilia FVIII/FIX Replacement Therapy Tool User Guide
map.输入患者体重、目标凝血因子活性和当前活性，按公式「体重×目标差值×0.5」计算单: Enter patient weight, target coagulation factor activity and current activity, and compute the single FVIII or FIX replacement dose (IU) with the formula 'weight x target difference x 0.5', then derive the dosing interval and treatment course, helping clinicians quickly plan replacement therapy for hemophilia bleeding or the perioperative period.
map.出血/围手术期按体重与目标活性算单次因子剂量（IU）: For bleeding or the perioperative period, compute the single factor dose (IU) from weight and target activity
map.按因子半衰期定给药间隔（FVIII 8–12h、FIX 18–24h）: Set the dosing interval by factor half-life (FVIII 8-12 h, FIX 18-24 h)
map.大剂量或存在抑制物时改旁路制剂，不单纯加量: For large doses or when inhibitors are present, switch to a bypassing agent rather than simply increasing the dose
map.：替代剂量(IU)=体重(kg)×目标差值(%)×系数（FVIII 0.5、FI: : Replacement dose (IU) = weight (kg) x target difference (%) x coefficient (FVIII 0.5, FIX 1.0), rounded to 10 IU. Logic: 1 IU/kg of FVIII raises activity by about 2% and FIX by about 1%, so the amount needed to reach the target = weight x difference / rise per IU/kg. Expected peak = current + round(dose/weight/rise per IU/kg).
map.：例（体重 70 kg、当前 1%、关节出血目标 40%）：FVIII 系数 0: : Example (weight 70 kg, current 1%, target 40% for joint bleeding): FVIII coefficient 0.5, dose = 70 x (40 - 1) x 0.5 = 1365, rounded to 1370 IU (19.6 IU/kg); expected peak = 1 + round(1370/70/2) = 1 + 10 = 11%. Note: a single dose can reach the joint bleeding target (30-50%); dose every 8-12 h according to the FVIII half-life of 8-12 h.

map.为什么 FIX 系数是 FVIII 的 2 倍？: Why is the FIX coefficient twice that of FVIII?
map.因 1 IU/kg FIX 仅提升活性约 1%（FVIII 约 2%），达到同等: Because 1 IU/kg of FIX raises activity by only about 1% (FVIII about 2%), reaching the same increment needs about twice the IU/kg; FIX also has a longer half-life and different distribution, so clinical dosing is less frequent.
map.剂量很大就安全吗？: Is a larger dose automatically safer?
map.不一定。若存在抑制物，加大因子剂量无效甚至促敏，应改用旁路制剂（rFVIIa/A: Not necessarily. If an inhibitor is present, increasing the factor dose is ineffective and may even promote sensitization; switch to a bypassing agent (rFVIIa/APCC) and consider immune tolerance induction (ITI); for a single dose >3000 IU, recovery should also be confirmed.
